Mostly women and children | Regime rocket fire on western countryside of Aleppo leaves many injured

SOHR activists have documented the injury of four civilians, including two children and a woman, as a result of rocket attacks by regime forces on the outskirts of Darat Izza town in the western countryside of Aleppo, in the “de-escalation zone”.

Earlier today, SOHR reported that Russian fighter jets carried out three airstrikes on the frontlines of al-Bara and Kansafra in Jabal al-Zawiyah in the south of Idlib. No casualties were reported. Today’s airstrikes came after Russian jets had suspended aerial operations on the “de-escalation zone” for about three days.
